name: hwm_lite_e12

training.validation: scene-held-out 1/16 of training scenes (hash rule train.validation_scene)

selection_rule: best validation NLL among candidates >=20% faster than legacy at P50 and P95 on every latency cohort, in every bracketed same-load benchmark in which the candidate was measured (vs the mean of the two bracketing legacy runs)
selection_note: hwm_lite2_e12 (validation NLL -16.851) passed in the loaded bracket but missed in the quiet bracket (representative P50 -19.7% vs the bracketing legacy mean); hwm_lite_e12 is not significantly worse on any paired development metric (2 of 33 cells nominally favour it; coverage-calibration gaps within noise; docs/stage1_hwm/RESULTS.md)
